contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5, so n=6 needs residual geometry) and with the packet C66-GEO-H0 subproblem (stratify the relative degree-six linear system by h^0). Independent primary check against SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (Canning–Larson arXiv:2208.02357v2 / JEMS 2024): deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f, so for the balanced f_2=5 summand at g=6 one has deg(W_5)=16. Packet CE convention L:=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} then has deg L=16-(2g-2)=6, and Riemann–Roch gives χ(L)=deg-g+1=1, hence h^0(L)=1+h^1(L) on every smooth genus-6 fibre. Serre duality identifies h^1(L)=h^0(ω_C⊗L^{-1}); substituting L^{-1}=ω_C⊗W_5^∨ yields ω_C⊗L^{-1}=ω_C^2⊗W_5^∨=:M with deg M=2(2g-2)-16=4. Thus h^0(L)=1+h^0(M) fibrewise, with no appeal to the undischarged GAP-Z-W5D identification W_5≅ω_C^2(-D). Consequently the C66-GEO-H0 stratification by h^0(L) is equivalent to the h^0-stratification of this relative degree-4 line bundle M, and h^0(L)=3 (fibrewise |L|≅P^2) holds precisely where h^0(M)=2. Mild scope sharpening only: 'g^1_4-type Brill–Noether' refers to the Brill–Noether stratification of this specific relative bundle M (equivalently L), not the full W^1_4 of the curve; the finding does not assert constancy of h^0(L)=3 on the whole balanced locus (that remains FND-0058). Compatible with and complementary to corroborated FND-0005 (χ(L)=1 nonemptiness of Z), FND-0047 (relative linear-system care when h^0 jumps), FND-0058 (constancy needed for a global relative P^2), FND-0062/FND-0063 (f=4 obstruction vanishes; f=5 failure iff O_C(Γ)≅L). Distinct from those: do not merge. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent verification of the RR+Serre arithmetic against SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 and the packet degree conventions. Merge target: none.
